title: CurseCore Field: Troubleshooting
summary: Fix curse and cleansing failures by checking player state, minor-curse gates, and optional bridges.

blocks.title: Common Failure
blocks.body: Cleansing usually fails because no active minor curse exists, the player data did not persist, or an optional bridge was called directly instead of safely.

blocks.title: Shrink The Case
blocks.body: Apply Echo Rot, verify the stored state, then run the smallest cleansing path. Do not test every future curse at once.

blocks.title: One Fix At A Time
blocks.body: Fix persistence, then scanning, then cleansing events. A broken scan can make a good cleanse look broken.

blocks.title: Retest Cleanly
blocks.body: Change one variable, test on a smaller route, and keep the fix only if the failure becomes easier to explain.
